coatue._readme: Identity merges for Coatue. One source of duplication: the filing layers name a company by its registered name while the firm's portfolio page uses the brand (Neutron Holdings / Lime, Raintank / Grafana Labs, Tendril Holdings / Uplight, Kanzhun / BOSS Zhipin, Magical Tome / Tome). Canonical is the rendering on the firm's live portfolio page. Written 2026-09-26 after the first build and before any judged verdict; the base was rebuilt and re-prepared on it the same hour.

merges.reason: Neutron Holdings, Inc. is the registered name of Lime (Form D 2017q4 naming Thomas Laffont; Coatue led Lime's 2017 Series B)
Raintank, Inc. is the registered name of Grafana Labs (Form D 2021q3 naming David Schneider; Coatue led the 2021 Series C)
Tendril Holdings, LLC is the holding company of Uplight (formed from Tendril and Simple Energy in 2019; Form D 2021q4 naming Jaimin Rangwalla)
Kanzhun Limited (Nasdaq: BZ) is the listed company behind BOSS Zhipin, which the firm's page lists by its brand (Schedule 13G 2022-2023)

merges.name: Tome
merges.reason: Magical Tome, Inc. (San Francisco, incorporated 2020) is the registered name of Tome (Form D 2021q3 naming Dan Rose); the builder's name-variant rule folded it into the unrelated Magical

merges.name: Jetify
merges.reason: Jetpack.io renamed itself Jetify in 2023; the firm's page lists the company under both names

merges.name: Mason
merges.reason: The firm's page renders the company as 'By Mason' (its domain is bymason.com); the brand is Mason. The archive captures carry the page's rendering, the live list the brand, so the builder made two rows of one company

merges.name: Norm Ai
merges.reason: Nomos Ai Inc. is the registered name of Norm Ai (SiliconANGLE, 2026-07-07: 'Nomos Ai Inc. ... which goes by the business name Norm Ai'); the Form D of November 2025 naming Peter Wallace and Sri Viswanath is Norm Ai's. Found by the blind re-judgment

merges.name: Lindy
merges.reason: Lindy is a pivot of Teamflow and the same legal entity, in its founder's words (SaaS Club podcast, https://saasclub.io/podcast/lindy-flo-crivello-450/); the firm lists the company under both names. Found by the blind re-judgment, 2026-09-27

never_merge.reason: Two companies: Magical (the text-expander app the firm lists) and Magical Tome, Inc., the registered name of Tome.
Two companies the firm lists separately: Sunday (restaurant payments, Atlanta; Sunday App, Inc. PBC on Form D) and Sunday Robotics.
